terminology.population_metric: Population potentially exposed within simulated flood extent
terminology.disclaimer: These metrics represent model-estimated scenario exposures derived from spatial intersection of 2D SWE flood depth grids against WorldPop 2020 raster data and OpenStreetMap settlement centroids. They are scenario estimates for disaster planning and decision support, not confirmed casualties or ground truth.

spatial_operations: Point-in-grid continuous bilinear and cell sampling for settlement coordinates
Area-average zonal raster reprojection from ~185m SWE grid to ~1km WorldPop grid
Continuous arrival time tracking per grid cell: min(t) where depth >= 0.1m
Time-dependent timestep zonal evaluation vs. maximum extent union
datasets_missing: Road network vectors (requires OSM Highway layer)
Critical facility footprints (hospitals, schools, power, railways)

roads.reason: Road network vector layer is not present in workspace. Zero-invention policy active.

bridges.reason: Bridge structure vector layer is not present in workspace. Zero-invention policy active.

critical_facilities.reason: Critical infrastructure layer is not present in workspace. Zero-invention policy active.
